name: MC GamerTime
description: Board game inventory, session log, Elo leaderboard, player profiles and achievements. Native React/FastAPI deployment with SQLite and local media storage, maintained by Razzo Scripts.

app_vars.name: var_admin_user
app_vars.label: Initial Admin Username
app_vars.help: 3-32 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.

app_vars.name: var_admin_password
app_vars.label: Initial Admin Password
app_vars.help: 12-72 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters. Leave empty to generate a random password printed after installation.

app_vars.name: var_bgg_token
app_vars.label: Board Game Geek API Token
app_vars.help: Optional; game search is disabled without a BGG token. Can be added to the configuration later.

notes.text: Testing: syntax and mocked behavior can be checked locally; a real Proxmox VE installation, browser login, runtime dependency builds and ARM64 have not been verified. Native deployment reproduces the upstream Dockerfile and entrypoint, not an upstream-supported bare-metal installer.

Access https://<container-IP> on port 443 and accept the self-signed certificate. HTTP port 80 redirects to HTTPS; FastAPI port 4263 listens only on loopback. HTTPS is needed for the PWA service worker. For trusted PWA installation use a browser-trusted TLS certificate.

The initial username defaults to admin and the password is generated unless supplied. Credentials are read back from the CT and printed after installation. After first login clear BOTH ADMIN_USERNAME and ADMIN_PASSWORD in /opt/mc-gamertime_data/.env and restart mc-gamertime; bootstrap credentials are otherwise stored in plaintext.

SQLite, uploaded media, JWT signing secret and configuration live in /opt/mc-gamertime_data and are never replaced during updates. Updates build in a staging directory before stopping the service; failed activation restores previous code. SQLite migrations are not rolled back: snapshot/back up the CT before upgrades, and check upstream release notes.

Optional BGG_TOKEN enables game search. Add SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD and SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS to the systemd EnvironmentFile for password-reset email. Set APP_BASE_URL to your public HTTPS URL if using a domain or changing the container IP; without SMTP upstream logs reset links in the service journal.
